title: The armourer's yard
teaches: A bout with your own kit
blurb: A ruined smithy, an old soldier and his notes. Make your own arms, test them, and bout with him.
after: Good things take steps, and a tool before the thing. Kit you made yourself, you can mend.
refines: Does several-step making read well (a part, then the thing)? Are made weapons and armour classed and felt in a bout?
goal: Make, test and try your own arms

things.name: Holt's notes on arms
things.description: A battered leather book of notes in a soldier's square hand: how to make arms from what's lying about. Pick it up and read it.

things.name: broken sword blade
things.description: Half of a broken sword: a good iron blade snapped a foot from the hilt, rusty but sound.

things.name: ash pole
things.description: A straight, seasoned ash pole, two yards long.

things.name: rawhide strips
things.description: A coil of stiff rawhide strips: soak them and they'll bind anything.

things.name: rawhide strips
things.description: Another coil of stiff rawhide strips, by the woodpile.

things.name: old hatchet
things.description: An old hatchet with a nicked edge, for splitting and trimming wood.

things.name: bolt of linen
things.description: A bolt of coarse unbleached linen, free to use.

things.name: sack of wool
things.description: A sack of raw fleece wool, greasy and thick.

things.name: old shears
things.description: A pair of old iron shears, for cloth and leather.

things.name: needle and thread
things.description: A big sail needle threaded with waxed linen thread.

things.name: oak boards
things.description: A few short oak boards from an old door.

things.name: grindstone
things.description: A big sandstone grindstone with a crank: for grinding edges and points.

things.name: quenching trough
things.description: A stone trough of water for quenching and soaking.

things.name: straw dummy
things.description: A practice dummy of straw-stuffed sacking on a post, with a painted scowl. Hit it all you like.

things.name: practice staff
things.description: Holt's stout ash practice staff, its ends padded with leather.

things.name: old quilted jack
things.description: Holt's faded red quilted jack, patched at the elbows.

spars.says: Ha! Eager, are we? Practice only, then.

steps.title: The old smithy
cards: …signal. A ruined smithy on the road to the forest. Sergeant Holt lives here, and his notes on arms lie on the bench.
He won't arm you: you must make it yourself, so you can mend it. Good things take steps: a tool, then the thing.
There's no one right way. The notes have some; you may know others. The device helps if you ask (H).

steps.title: A weapon
cards: Make yourself a weapon worth the name from what's in the yard.
steps.done: Made, not found. You know how it's put together, so you can mend it.
help: Holt's notes are on the workbench: pick them up and read them ({Space} with them in hand).
A broken blade is no use until it has a point; a point is no use until it has a haft.

playtest.do: grind the broken end of the sword blade to a sharp spear point on the grindstone
seat the spearhead in the split end of the ash pole and bind it tight with the rawhide strips

2.do: lash the broken sword blade crosswise to the end of the ash pole with soaked rawhide to make a heavy bill-hook polearm

try_also: sharpen the broken blade into a spearhead on the grindstone

steps.title: Something to keep blows off
cards: Now make something to keep a blow off you: armour, or a shield.
steps.done: Steel is better, but quilted linen has saved more lives.
help: The notes have a quilted jack (linen, wool, a needle) and a buckler (boards and rawhide).

playtest.do: cut the linen into two layers, stuff the wool between them and quilt it into a padded jack with the needle and thread

2.do: cut a round buckler from the oak boards and bind its rim with soaked rawhide

steps.title: On the dummy
cards: Take up your weapon and put on what you made, then show Holt it works: on the dummy.
steps.done: It bites. Better learned on straw.
help: Open Pack & gear ({I}) to take it up and put things on.
Then try it on the dummy where Holt can see.

playtest.do: thrust my spear hard into the straw dummy to show Holt it holds and bites

2.do: hack at the straw dummy with my polearm to show Holt it holds and bites

try_also: stab the dummy with the spear

steps.title: A bout
cards: Last: a bout with Holt, with what you made. Walk up to him armed. Practice only.

do.text: On guard, then. Let's see what you've made.

on_done.text: Hm. You'll do. If you go by the forest road, keep that close.

on_done.lead: Two deserters rob travellers on the forest road to the ford.
on_done.said: Two deserters work the forest road.

steps.done: Made, tested and tried. That's how you know your kit.
help: Walk up to Holt with your weapon ready. Watch his wind-up; raise your guard ({F}) or step back.

reactions.killed: …You killed someone. That can't be undone. Rewind from the menu if that isn't what you meant.
reactions.arrested: They've taken you away. Rewind from the menu to try again.
reactions.dead: You died. Rewind to the last calm moment and try something else.
